verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's rollback docs state you can roll back to a previously deployed version of a Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no further detail. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that rollback is truly one-click in the dashboard, confirmation that any prior version (not just recent ones) can be targeted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
